about.title: Pa lwa
about.intro: {project} ni platifomu ya nshita imo iya ukugabana amafayilo kwa peer-to-peer iyaakulwa pa ma teknologia ya kale ayashili kuyendelele. Iyalanga interface yasuma iya umubomfi pamo na ubumi bwa lyonse ubushili kuyendelele, iyapeela ukugabana ubufyashi ubushinguluka kabili ubwa kucetekelwa kwabula ukushintilila pa bukulu bonse ubwa kuyendelele. Pulojekiti yene ni open source, ileyatwa pansi pa {license}.

decentralized.title: Network ya lyonse iyashili kuyendelele
decentralized.description: Tapaba ma server ayendelelelwa, tapaba icingi cimo ica kupwilisha. Abakubomfya bafwaya na ukupokelela ifyebo ku numa ku banabo, ukwabula ukushintilila pa indexer, tracker nangu database iyendelelelwa iili yonse.

accessControl.title: Ukutungulula ukwa kufika kwa makosa
accessControl.description: Onse engatampe network yakwe wine ukwabula ukulipila kabili na amafunde yakwe wine. Mu network onse, longanya imisango ya bakubomfya: umwine, admin, kashishimika, moderator na kashipikifya. Tungulula icine cine ni nani engashishimika, moderate na kushipikifya ifyebo.

ui.title: Interface ya umubomfi iyabuubama
ui.description: Interface ya media center iyasuma kabili iya cibusa, iyalengwa pa desktop, TV na ma platifomu ya selifoni. Ukutambala kwasuma ne keyboard, mouse, gamepad nangu remote. Abakubomfya abakulu bengabomfya software pamo nge file server ukwabula ukutambika ukubomfya command-line interface.

dataFormat.title: Ifimo fya ifyebo ifyabelengwa nabantu
dataFormat.description: Icimo ca ifyebo ica LISH cashintwe pa JSON, ukulenga ukulemba, ukubelenga na ukumfwa ukwa kuyangufyanya. Gabana ifyebo fyobe ne metadata iyaonekana kabili iyamoneka, onse engalola panshipa.

security.title: Ubuteyu na ubuteyanyo
security.description: Ukulanshanya konse ukwa peer-to-peer kwakwatwa encryption, ukulenga ifyebo fyobe ukushala mu mfimba ilyo fileenda. Abakubomfya bengafisama mu numa ya VPN ukukushishanya icipingo cimbi ica kushilamo. {project} ifyula ubuteyu bobe pa cilengelwa cakwe.

crossPlatform.title: Cross-platform
crossPlatform.description: Software yapezewa pa Windows, Linux na macOS. Ibomfye pa cikwama conse ico ulefwaya.

download.title: Kupokelela
download.description: Pokelela {project} ya platifomu yobe. Ukupokelela konse ni ukwa fwaka kabili open source.
